content: Ye n kuɑ sɔ̃ɔ mɛɛru, ɑlikɑmɑ ɡɛ̃ɛbun sɑɑ, Sɑnsom u boo kpɛmu ɡɑɡu suɑ u kɑ win kurɔ berɑm dɑ. Ye u turɑ mi, yerɑ u win dokiri sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ kĩ n dɑ nɛn kurɔn dirɔ. Adɑmɑ dokiri wi, u yinɑ.
U nɛɛ, nɑ tɑmɑɑ ɑǹ mɑɑ nùn kĩwɑ mɑm mɑm. Mɑ nɑ nùn wunɛn bɔrɔ kɑ̃. Win wɔnɔ wee, ɑ nùn suo kɔsire. U mɑɑ nùn burɑm kere.
Sɑnsom u nɛɛ, nɑ̀ n Filisitibɑ kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ tɛ̃, nɑǹ ko nɑ n tɑɑrɛ mɔ ye sɔɔ.
Mɑ u doonɑ u sɛ̃usu ɡoobɑ wunɔbu (300) mwɑ u sin sinu bɔkuɑ yiru yiru. Yerɑ u wii bɔnnu sɔrisi nin sii nin suunu sɔɔ.
Mɑ u wii bɔn ni dɔ̃ɔ doke u sɛ̃u si sure Filisitibɑn ɑlikɑmɑ ɡbɑɑnɔ. Ye bɑ ɡɑ̃ bɑ subɑ kɑ ye bɑǹ ɡɛ̃ɛbu kpɑ sere kɑ ben dɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑɑnɔ mi bɑ olifibɑ duurɑ, kpuro yɑ dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑwɑ.
Mɑ Filisitibɑ bɑ nɛɛ, wɑrɑ u sun yenin bweseru kuɑ. Mɑ ben ɡɑbɑ nɛɛ, Sɑnsom, Tinnɑɡibun dokiriwɑ, yèn sɔ̃ bɑ win kurɔ wɔrɑ bɑ ɡoo kɑ̃. Mɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ kurɔ wi kɑ win tundo mwɑ bɑ bu dɔ̃ɔ mɛni.
Sɑnsom u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, yeniwɑ i mɔ̀? Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, nɑǹ derimɔ nɑ kun mɔru kɔsie.
Mɑ u bu wɔri kɑ dɑm u bu ɡo tɑ sɑkɑ sɑrɑ. Mɑ u dɑ u wɑ̃ɑ Etɑmun kpee bɑɑ sɔɔ.
Sɑnsom u Filisitibɑ kɑmiɑ
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Filisitibɑ bɑ seewɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ ben sɑnsɑni ɡirɑ Yudɑbɑn temɔ bɑ tɛrie sere Lekiɔ.
Ye Yudɑbɑ bɑ bu wɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mbɑ n kuɑ i kɑ sun wɔrimɑ mɛni. Bɑ nɛɛ, Sɑnsomwɑ sɑ kɑsu su mwɑ su bɔke su nùn kuɑ nɡe mɛ u sun kuɑ.

Yerɑ Yudɑbɑn tɔnu nɔrɔbun subɑ itɑ (3.000) bɑ seewɑ bɑ dɑ Etɑmun kpee bɑɑ mi, bɑ Sɑnsom deemɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑǹ yɛ̃ mɑ Filisitibɑrɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn yinnibu? Mbɑn bweserɑ ɑ sun kuɑ mɛni. Sɑnsom u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, nɡe mɛ ben tii bɑ mɑn kuɑ, nɡe mɛyɑ nɑ mɑɑ bu kuɑ.
Bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, sɑ nɑwɑ su kɑ nun mwɑ su bɔke su nun Filisitibɑ nɔmu bɛriɑ. Mɑ u nɛɛ, i bɔ̃ruo bɛɛn tii i kun mɑn ɡoomɔ.
Bɑ nɛɛ, yɑ wɑ̃. Sɑ kĩ su nun bɔkewɑ su nun Filisitibɑ nɔmu bɛriɑ. Sɑǹ nun ɡoomɔ. Mɑ bɑ nùn bɔkuɑ kɑ wɛ̃ɛ kpɛɛ yiru. Bɑ nùn yɑrɑmɑ kpee bɑɑ yen min di.
Ye u turɑ Lekiɔ, Filisitibɑ bɑ nùn sennɔ nɑ kɑ wure bɑkɑnu. Sɑɑ yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔn Hunde u nùn yɔɔwɑ. Mɑ u wɛ̃ɛ yi bɑ kɑ nùn bɔkuɑ kɑsukɑ yi kuɑ nɡe wɛ̃ɛ yi yi dɔ̃ɔ soorɑ. Mɑ yi wɔrumɑ win nɔmɑn di.
Yerɑ u kɛtɛkun bɑɑ sɑburo beku ɡɑɡu dɔbɑ u kɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbu (1.000) ɡo.
Mɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: Nɑ bu subɑ subɑ nɡe tɑkɑnu.

content: Ye u ɡɑri yi sɑɑrɑ u kpɑ, mɑ u kɛtɛkun bɑɑ sɑburo ɡe kɔ̃. Mɑ bɑ yɑm mi yĩsiru kɑ̃ Rɑmɑti Leki. Yĩsi ten tubusiɑnɑ bɑɑ sɑburon ɡunɡuru.

Yen biru nim nɔru ɡɑ Sɑnsom kuɑ ɡem ɡem. Yerɑ u Yinni Gusunɔ somiru kɑnɑ u nɛɛ, wunɑ ɑ derɑ nɑ nɛn tɔmbu fɑɑbɑ bɑkɑ yeni kuɑ. Tɛ̃ kɑɑ de n ɡbiwɑ kɑ nim nɔru? Kpɑ n wɔri tɔn tuko be bɑǹ bɑnɡo kuen nɔmɑ sɔɔ?

Yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ nim mu yɑrɑ kpee wɔru ɡɑɡun min di Leki mi, mɑ yɑ kuɑ nim nɔnu. Sɑnsom u nɔrɑ mɑ win hunde yɑ wurɑmɑ, u dɑm kuɑ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ nim nɔnu ɡe sokɑ Eni Hɑkore. Yen tubusiɑnɑ, wi u somiru kɑnɑn nim nɔnu. Gɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi sere kɑ ɡisɔn ɡisɔ.
Sɑnsom u kuɑwɑ Isirelibɑn kpɑro wɔ̃ɔ yɛndu sɑɑ ye Filisitibɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ ben yinnibu.
